classes.name_en: Signature collections to initiate referendums and bills
classes.disposition_reason: Voters sign in support; there is no ballot and no choice between options, so a signature count is not an election result. The archive keeps the referendums that a successful collection triggers.

classes.name: Tiesnešu apstiprināšana
classes.disposition_reason: No judge or prosecutor is elected by voters: the Saeima confirms judges (Satversme art. 84) and Constitutional Court justices (art. 85).

classes.name: Pastarpinātas vēlēšanas
classes.disposition_reason: Officers and bodies chosen by elected bodies, not voters: council chairs and deputies by each council, district councils of 1997-2009 formed from local council chairs, planning region development councils, the Speaker, and the Cabinet's confidence vote in the Saeima.

classes.name: Pašvaldības referendums

classes.name: Iedzīvotāju padomes
classes.disposition_reason: Consultative councils set up by each municipality under Pašvaldību likums art. 58 and chosen by residents' meetings under the municipality's own rules; no electoral authority runs them or compiles returns.
